name: fireworks
summary: Successfully obtained a chat completion from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API. Used curl to POST to https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/chat/completions with the FIREWORKS_API_KEY environment variable. The model accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2 responded with "¡Hola!" (and reasoning_content) in a valid chat.completion object.
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1", but that model returned "Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed". I queried the available models endpoint and used "accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2" instead, which worked. This appears to be a documentation/model-availability mismatch on the vendor side.

installed.evidence: Transcript shows no command installing a Fireworks SDK or CLI; only system curl is used.

configured.evidence: First curl returned a model NOT_FOUND error instead of an auth error, confirming $FIREWORKS_API_KEY was present and valid.
